depthAssumption: Original observed RA/DEC and photometry are retained as catalogue data. Rays are registered through the fixed reference-image WCS and its accepted Alignment fit to the simulation cloud. Depths are a deterministic density-conditioned display realization, not measured stellar distances or new astrometry. Candidate image material never selects or moves stars.

photometry.display: Diameter squared × opacity × encoded-RGB luminance follows relative V-band flux until the diameter/opacity ceiling. No faint-star opacity floor.
photometry.limitation: A bounded display-light proxy on an sRGB CSS surface, not calibrated screen radiance or physical stellar diameter.

depthModel.integratedSignal: Pinned target.png unflopped, Rec.709 encoded RGB luminance, global maximum normalization; identical createIntegratedSignalSampler to cloud-density preparation.
depthModel.method: Conditional depth PDF proportional to actual coherent extended cloud RGB emission maximum times decoded stellar density times (1+z/D)^2. 1536 intervals span cloud support; a fixed SHA-256 source-ID quantile inverts its piecewise-linear CDF. Chosen points must have strictly positive true joint support. No plane, added thickness, jitter or zero-support fallback.
depthModel.limitation: Cloud-conditioned display placement, not measured distances. The reconstructed emission and population-agnostic, clipped/quantized simulation mass density are model assumptions. No bright-star selection function or physical cloud membership is inferred.

inheritedProvenance.selection: Table 3 published massive LMC stars with finite Johnson V <= 16, inside the full native SMASH WCS footprint. No foreground catalogue added; this is an incomplete massive-star sample, not all LMC stars.
inheritedProvenance.color: Published B-V mapped through the existing catalogue display-color approximation; white when B absent. No dereddening. Point area and opacity preserve magnitude-derived relative display light with color compensation. Finite display sizes are not measured stellar diameters; the screen is not a radiometric instrument.

provenance.positions: One common measured-ray to reference-UV to fitted-model-ray transport; IDs, original RA/DEC and photometry are unchanged.
provenance.depth: Existing 1536-interval conditional CDF with fixed SHA256 source-ID quantile; PDF is decoded stellar density times (1+z/D)^2. Every selected point must have strictly positive source support.
provenance.support: The common encoded full-density projected signal controls cutoff; membership is all-light. Physically supported stars below projection quantization retain zero signal and remain visible at cutoff0. No candidate image, color, texture or coverage input exists.
provenance.limitation: An authored image/simulation registration and inferred depth realization; rendered model rays after the fit are not claimed as measured celestial coordinates.
